individuals.treatment_summary: Thalidomide, glucocorticoid, infliximab, adalimumab. Developed severe hormone-dependent allergic reactions during treatment with glucocorticoids, thalidomide and infliximab; symptoms improved after switching to adalimumab. Follow-up 2y3m: improvement in digestive tract symptoms but persistent cecal ulcers (ulcer in the ileocecal region).

individuals.treatment_summary: Thalidomide and glucocorticoid (corticosteroids). Diagnosed with methylmalonic aciduria and received hydroxocobalamin 1 mg daily; after one week urine organic acid screening and blood homocysteine normalized and the dose was tapered to 1.5 mg weekly. Follow-up 3y: symptoms and endoscopic findings completely relieved.
